name: reconcile-failfast-theme-navigation
body: Source: previous spec said (a) collect all errors in one pass, (b) theme named `ey` (default `ey`), (c) `navigation: linear | free`, default `linear`. Inconsistency: user decisions supersede these. Resolution: (1) validation is fail-fast — first error only, one clear error (file, full path, problem, fix hint) in terminal and live-reload browser error page; (2) the single built-in EY-look theme is named `default`; `theme` optional, default `default`, only allowed value `default`, future themes addable; (3) `navigation` uses reveal.js navigationMode values `default | linear | grid`, default `default`; `links-only` stays parked. Updated nodes: whole-deck-validation, error-reporting, cli-start, live-reload-error-page, theme-selection, deck-config, navigation-mode, parked-kiosk-interactivity, decision-validation-defaults, domain deck-config/theme/deck-rebuilt/validate-deck, solution theme-registry/deck-validator/embedded-assets/renderer. [with user]
